# UXUE Company Ltd

UXUE is a technology-first security and ICT integration company based in Nairobi, Kenya. The company designs and deploys physical security, enterprise networking, security automation, ICT equipment and cybersecurity solutions for organisations in Kenya and East Africa.

- Home: https://uxue.co.ke/

- Contact: https://uxue.co.ke/contact
